hook_line: INDIAN IT STOCKS PLUNGE UP TO 5% AS AI RALLY RESUMES

hook_stat.sub: Mphasis and Infosys fell about 5% each on Wednesday

news_summary: Indian IT stocks plunged for a second straight session on Wednesday, with Mphasis and Infosys down about 5% each and the Nifty IT index down more than 3%, as a rebound in the global AI trade weighed on software services shares.
payoff: The two-day fall has erased a large block of market value from the sector's biggest names.
